summary: Build slice 1 of 3: the Rust Files-explorer core, its command shells and registration, the typed window boundary, and the pure explorer-root helper, each with tests. Added src-tauri/src/features/mod.rs and src-tauri/src/features/explorer/{mod.rs,commands.rs}: list_level reads exactly one directory level, hides node_modules/.git/target/dist unless show_hidden, sorts folders first then files, caps at 1000 returned / 10000 scanned with total+truncated, and reports an unreadable folder as locked rather than an error; drives() lists Windows drive roots via GetLogicalDrives. Both run on tauri::async_runtime::spawn_blocking behind explorer_list/explorer_drives, registered in lib.rs (pub mod features so integration tests can reach it). Enabled windows-sys Win32_Storage_FileSystem in Cargo.toml (Cargo.lock unchanged). Added src/api/explorer.ts (explorerApi.list/drives, typed Entry/Listing) with a test pinning command names and camelCase args, and src/features/explorer/root.ts (explorerRoot, parentFolder, isDriveRoot) reusing ownerOf for the deepest owning app, Misc parent-folder roots, drive-list climbing and the no-root hint, with tests. Verified: rustfmt on new files, cargo clippy --all-targets -D warnings, cargo test --test explorer (12 pass), npm run lint, targeted vitest (18 pass), npm run build. Note: the full `npm test` has one deterministic pre-existing failure unrelated to this slice (src/App.test.tsx:367 expects footer text v2.0.0 while the app is 2.1.0 on HEAD 396aed6) plus two Ctrl+Shift+P palette tests that only time out under full-suite load and pass when run alone. No tracked frontend source changed, so those are not from this slice. R1/R3 UI work (palette entry, useExplorer/ExplorerPanel/Sidebar wiring, version bump) belongs to later slices. Build slice 2 of 3: the Files explorer window half. Added useExplorer (one directory level per request, lazy per-folder expansion cached with a 100-level LRU cap, Show hidden refetch, locked-on-failure, and Misc Up navigation to the drive list that is discarded whenever the view/app/active tab root changes) and the ExplorerPanel (Files section with Up, Show hidden toggle, lazy folder tree, truncation text, and file clicks delegated to the editor's existing open path). The sidebar gained an optional explorer slot rendered below the apps in the expanded pane and never in the collapsed rail, with characterization tests pinning the existing rows and rail. The core, commands, lib registration, api/explorer and root helper were already present from the earlier slice and are reused unchanged. typecheck, the three affected test files (32 tests), and npm run build pass; the full suite is 477 passed with 2 known pre-existing failures (App.test.tsx footer version v2.0.0, and App.shortcuts palette timeout under full-suite load). Revision 1 complete. The window now wires the accepted design end to end: App.tsx computes the Files explorer root with explorerRoot (selected app root in the app view, the deepest owning app root of the active editor tab in the editor view, a Misc file's parent folder otherwise), passes it to the new ExplorerPanel in the Sidebar explorer slot with a reset key that discards temporary Up navigation, and opens explorer files through editor.openPath (the same editor_open_any path the picker uses). The sidebar renders with the Files section even with zero apps when a loose file applies, and the Home row only when apps exist. A new unconditional 'Open file…' command-palette action calls editor.openDialog, the same picker the toolbar Open… button, Ctrl+O and the empty-state 'Open a file…' button already use. The version moves to 2.2.0 in package.json, package-lock.json, src-tauri/Cargo.toml, src-tauri/Cargo.lock and src-tauri/tauri.conf.json. Existing App suites gained an api/explorer mock (empty listing) and longer waits on lazy dialogs so their behaviour is pinned unchanged. Added App-level tests for R1/R3/R4/R5/A4, a Sidebar explorer test file for R2/A3/A4, and a version test for A2. Checks run and green: npm run lint, npm test (full), cargo test --test explorer, npm run build, rustfmt --check on new Rust files, cargo clippy --all-targets (0 warnings).
